entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Upendra Yadav - Advocate for petitioner.
Shri N.K. Gupta - Public Prosecutor for State.

Order 
This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking the following reliefs:-
"It is therefore, most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to allow this petition and the FIR registered at Crime No.026/2020 at Police Station Kotwali Morena for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468 of IPC may kindly be quashed and petitioner may kindly be acquitted from all the offences."
At the outset, counsel for petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition.
It is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn.
